description: Estimate the credits a pipeline run would cost before running it, with the same input you would pass to run_pipeline. Returns estimated_mc (the expected charge, in millicredits; 1000 = 1 credit), reservation_mc (what the run holds when it starts) and, for automatic model choice, the model it would route to. A run that holds its credits step by step also returns ceiling_mc, the most it can hold in total: it stops when the credits run out and keeps what it finished. Use it to confirm the cost with the user before a paid run or a multi-step chain.

input.description: Pipeline input fields as a JSON object, as for run_pipeline. Unfinished inputs still return a price where the pipeline allows it.

pipeline_slug.description: The slug identifier of the pipeline (e.g., 'video-cut', 'image-generator')

name: estimate_pipeline_cost
